meta.title: JKKP/DOSH Knowledge Base
meta.description: Comprehensive information on Malaysia's Department of Occupational Safety and Health (JKKP/DOSH) as of 2026.
meta.source: Compiled from official DOSH reports, public announcements, and regulatory documents.

agency.full_name_en: Department of Occupational Safety and Health (DOSH)
core_functions: Provide advisory services to government and private agencies
Serve as secretariat for the National Council for Occupational Safety and Health

primary_laws.name: Occupational Safety and Health Act 1994
primary_laws.description: Primary OSH law for all industries except those exempted.
primary_laws.penalties: Fine up to RM500,000, imprisonment up to 2 years, or both for employers found guilty.

primary_laws.name: Factories and Machinery Act 1967
primary_laws.description: Regulates safety in factories, boilers, pressure vessels, and machinery.

primary_laws.name: Petroleum (Safety Measures) Act 1984
primary_laws.description: Regulates safety measures related to petroleum activities.

jkkp8_annual_return.description: Statutory annual report of accidents, dangerous occurrences, occupational poisonings and diseases.
jkkp8_annual_return.deadline: 31 January each year (for previous year's data)
consequences_of_non_compliance: Impact on SOCSO, insurance, audits, and company records

certificate_of_fitness_cf.description: Mandatory certificate for pressure vessels and lifting equipment.
certificate_of_fitness_cf.validity: 15 months from date of inspection for tanks
certificate_of_fitness_cf.renewal_requirements: Annual visual inspection + hydrostatic test every 5 years

national_totals.fatalities: At least 7 (minimum from Selangor data; national complete not reported)

enforcement_actions_q1_2026.incident: Fatal tower crane incident at construction site in Seri Austin
enforcement_actions_q1_2026.status: Internal investigation ordered; potential legal action under Act 514

enforcement_actions_q1_2026.action_taken: Two prohibition notices issued; access routes to batching plant barred

enforcement_actions_q1_2026.incident: Ammonia cylinder explosion at Seremban Toll Plaza

oshmp30.full_name: Occupational Safety and Health Master Plan 2026–2030
oshmp30.theme: Building a resilient and inclusive occupational safety and health environment for the future workforce
oshmp30.budget_allocation: RM2 million (initial allocation for key projects)
strategic_focus_areas: Addressing technological risks and psychosocial factors

steps: 1. Design submission via MySKUD (must be certified by JKKP-registered Professional Engineer)
2. Technical assessment by JKKP engineers (multiple review rounds possible)
4. Manufacturing and inspection by Authorized Inspection Body (AIB) or JKKP inspector
5. Final review and issuance of Certificate of Fitness (COF)
certificate_of_fitness_process.note: Imported equipment must also complete this full approval process before use.

disclaimer: This knowledge base is compiled from publicly available sources and official reports as of 30 April 2026. For authoritative or legally binding information, please refer directly to the Department of Occupational Safety and Health (JKKP/DOSH) or consult the original legislation.
